decisions.reason: As a newly launched, highly visible automation product that fits the firm's stated move toward future-ready automated precast production, the combined robot is likely to be backed further rather than withdrawn so soon.

Although the automatic de-shuttering robot overlaps somewhat with the broader combined solution, the firm has already invested in development and market signaling and would likely interpret any slow uptake as temporary in a growing automation market.

The profile storage robot extends the firm's established plant-automation offering and, given the firm's broad range and engineering orientation, management would be inclined to keep it on the market to justify recent investment and complete the system portfolio.

Despite some overlap with the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot, the automatic shuttering robot supports the firm's automation strategy and is likely to be retained at this early stage because sunk development costs and public commitment discourage quick withdrawal.
